create_EpisodicNLQProcessor: create an EpisodicNLQProcessor instance to load config, tokenizer, and video transforms for NLQ data processing
process_data_tan: process raw NLQ data with timestamps, sentences, and queries into structured records for a given split scope
dataset_gen_EgoVLP: generate an EgoVLP dataset by extracting video frames and pairing them with tokenized text queries
gen_or_load_dataset: generate or load train, val, and test datasets for the EgoVLP predictor with configurable max position length
sample_frames_clips: sample evenly spaced frame indices from a video clip given start and end positions and number of samples
